feature_drift.limitation: Descriptive synthetic distribution changes. KS statistics are not causal effects, real-world drift alerts or eligibility checks.

public_anchors.diagnostic_scope: Complete calendar-year synthetic observations, including adoption effects and observation noise. Gas includes positive consumers only. Not a real-world predictive validation.

energy.limitations: Meter aggregates are not individual banking records or evidence of adoption. A fitted lognormal is an approximation to published mean and median, not a reconstruction of meter microdata. Simulated adoption effects, missing months and observation noise change generated totals. Gas source year runs mid-May 2024 to mid-May 2025. GB excludes Northern Ireland.
energy.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
energy.title: Subnational electricity and gas consumption summary report 2024
energy.use: Public aggregate statistics anchor synthetic baseline annual demand marginals. Seasonal profiles, customer associations, observations and adoption labels remain synthetic.

split.method: GroupShuffleSplit on merchant_id; seeded row holdout of training merchants for known-merchant test

boundary_rules.name: fuel_marker
boundary_rules.description: PFS, PETROL or UNLEADED token anywhere in the text (e.g. 'TESCO PFS', 'SHELL PETROL').

boundary_rules.name: automotive_service
boundary_rules.description: TYRES, TYRE, MOT, AUTOCENTRE, AUTOCARE, or CAR SERVICE / CAR SERVICING / CAR WASH / CAR REPAIR / AUTO CENTRE phrases (e.g. 'KWIK FIT TYRES').

boundary_rules.name: dual_fuel
boundary_rules.description: Electricity and gas markers both present (dual-fuel supplier).

boundary_rules.name: electricity_only
boundary_rules.description: ELECTRICITY / ELECTRIC / ELEC with no gas marker and no non-supply word (EV charging, electric bikes, appliances).

boundary_rules.name: gas_only
boundary_rules.description: GAS with no electricity marker (e.g. 'CADENT GAS').

boundary_rules.name: bundled_utility
boundary_rules.description: ENERGY / UTILITIES / UTILITY / WATER, or the phrase DUAL FUEL, with no fuel-specific evidence (e.g. 'OCTOPUS ENERGY').
